slides.title: Profiling and Reducing Memory Overhead
slides.prompt: Python instances store attributes in dynamic `__dict__` dictionaries by default, creating overhead. Defining `__slots__` restricts attributes to a fixed-size array, dramatically reducing memory usage. Use `tracemalloc` for allocation tracing.
slides.codeSnippet:
import sys
import tracemalloc

class Point:
    __slots__ = ('x', 'y')
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y

tracemalloc.start()
p = Point(10, 20)
print(sys.getsizeof(p)) # Significantly smaller than standard class instances
